name: snippets
description: The snippet library: snippets, tags, variables and collections, saved as JSON in the app's data home. Every page plugin injects this one.
mount: a row `- id: snippets` / `name: snippets` before the page rows in blend.yaml; a page injects the `snippets` service

config.file: the JSON file, relative to the app's home (default snippets.json)
config.store: a Store port for tests (default: one JSON file under the app's home)
config.clock: what time it is, for tests (default: the system clock)
config.newId: how ids are made, for tests (default: a random UUID suffix)
